scope: independent actual fixed2000 transport/input/typed-result/verified-report/comparison evidence audit; no local SDK or JVM execution
limitations: This compares the matching serializable register/list scopes using unchanged original facts. Unknown and missing coverage never count as agreement.
Original SDK verifyV3 was actually run for every report on the hosted runner; this reviewer verifies raw evidence and classification without locally rerunning either checker.
855 register unknowns include own_read_mismatch coverage gaps; these require separate diagnosis and are not silently converted into serializability violations.
